items.name: Discovery
items.summary: Technical and product audit, clear priorities, and a concrete delivery plan.
items.fit: For teams that need to decide what to do before investing weeks of build.

items.name: MVP Sprint
items.summary: From problem to release: architecture, build, and ship to the store or an internal environment.
items.fit: For founders and teams that need a real MVP out the door, not a slide-deck prototype.

items.name: Fractional
items.summary: Dedicated days every month on product engineering, architecture, and unblocking the team.
includes: Ownership of critical features and technical debt
items.fit: For teams that want seniority without hiring full-time.
